title: Control of representation updating by higher-order thalamus enables history-based decision-making
goal: Reproduce the original Figure 3C and Figure 3G findings that PUL suppression and TRN activation reduce neuronal decoding of recent tone prevalence, retaining each panel's original neural inputs, sessions, paired control conditions and indispensable controls. Assess improvement only under an independently justified criterion for this same scientific finding; no such ordered criterion is currently qualified. Report candidate-versus-author decoder superiority separately.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Original empirical paired perturbation-versus-control prevalence-decoding contrasts in Figures 3C and 3G: both condition AUCs and paired differences for each source session, with panel-specific neural inputs, six tone identities, session/condition/animal identities, original training procedure and shuffled-label comparator. Preserve the source session-level reproduction and distinguish it from a new animal-level inferential claim. This named result does not imply every surrounding figure or whole-paper reproduction.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: secondary_empirical_method_extension: Candidate-versus-author decoder ROC-AUC comparison on authenticated original inputs and support. This is genuine empirical methodology; higher decoding AUC alone does not establish reproduction or improvement of the perturbation-versus-control biological finding. [coverage: source_supported_measurement_path_native_qualification_unresolved]
prospective_extension: New temporal or session-held-out evaluation remains separately labeled unless authenticated as the original source protocol. It cannot silently replace the original paired comparison.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
